provenance.method: Unmodified same-name polyphonic MIDI supplied in the repository; source-bound original quarter positions and melody fingerprints. Reference recording passes complete and per-section harmony/melody checks, with all four paths within 0.5 seconds, including any prelude. Explicitly selected additional recordings pass the same four paths; other recordings retain normal chroma-DTW correspondence checks. First reading is displayed from playback zero; this display time is not a measured sung onset. No printed-score verification or note edits are claimed.
